name: design-kit
summary: Single entry point for design work: route a Creative Director, maker or builder and visual critic across project assets, CMS references, Mobbin, DesignMD and 21st.dev, with required reads, a design pack handoff bound to the kit digest, rendered review and a source-to-output record.
side_effects: metered provider calls (21st code retrieval, DesignMD reads, brand lookups)
search text sent to third-party providers; client material only when the assignment covers it
image generation through the host's own image skill
project file changes when installing components or writing a design record
CMS output rounds only within an assigned CMS delivery
provider writes only on request (Mobbin collections)
triggers: pick a design system for this app
exclusions: live ui audit of a running app
standalone image generation, motion or video
